RedeemedNetAmount.name: Redeemed Net Amount
RedeemedNetAmount.definition: Net amount of money paid to the investor as a result of the redemption.

PartialRedemptionWithholdingAmount.name: Partial Redemption Withholding Amount
PartialRedemptionWithholdingAmount.definition: Amount retained by the Fund and paid out later at a time decided by the Fund.

SettlementDate.name: Settlement Date
SettlementDate.definition: Date on which the amount of money for the redemption is paid.
